title: Intelligence
that moves.
scenes.subtitle: From real-world data to intelligent action.
scenes.narration: The next era of AI moves beyond the screen. Into factories, robots, and the world around us.

title: Open tools.
Connected workflows.
scenes.subtitle: Bring your toolchain. Build on Nebius.
scenes.narration: Open tools. Leading models. One place to turn experiments into evidence. This is Workbench.

title: One source.
New conditions.
scenes.subtitle: Explore synthetic variations from source video.
scenes.narration: Use NVIDIA Cosmos to generate new conditions from source video. Inspect what changes, and what your task needs to preserve.

title: More models.
More possibilities.
scenes.subtitle: Open video generation, running on Nebius GPUs.
scenes.narration: Expand your options with Wan. Turn a prompt into video, with the model, seed, and generation settings recorded for the next experiment.

title: Make data quality visible.
scenes.subtitle: Inspect candidates. Compare results. Choose what moves forward.
scenes.narration: Bring candidates into FiftyOne. Review the visual results and their evaluation evidence together. Make the decision about what moves forward explicit, and inspectable.

title: Build skills
in simulation.
scenes.subtitle: Kitchen environments. Simulation data. Repeatable experiments.
scenes.narration: With RoboCasa, collect rollouts in simulated kitchens. Explore manipulation tasks and create structured data for the next policy experiment.

title: From simulation
to policy experiments.
scenes.subtitle: Train ACT policies. Inspect held-out rollouts.
scenes.narration: Train ACT policies with LeRobot. Inspect held-out rollouts. Keep the checkpoint, training data, and evaluation evidence available for each iteration.

title: Capture once.
Explore in 3D.
scenes.subtitle: Reconstruct a scene. Render new viewpoints.
scenes.narration: Neural reconstruction turns captured scenes into renderable worlds. Explore new camera viewpoints and inspect the geometry behind the view.

title: See. Reason.
Predict motion.
scenes.subtitle: An actual model result, open to inspection.
scenes.narration: Alpamayo connects camera inputs with driving reasoning and predicted motion. Here, a saved result identifies cones and predicts a path through the scene.
scenes.quote: Nudge left to avoid the cones on the right side.

title: Keep the evidence in view.
scenes.subtitle: Video, generation settings, and verified run artifacts.
scenes.narration: Inspect outputs in Rerun. Bring video and run evidence into the same view, and trace each result back to its generation settings.

title: Your toolchain.
One Workbench.
scenes.subtitle: Open-source tools and NVIDIA models, connected through NPA.
scenes.narration: SkyPilot runs the GPU work. Workbench connects your tools and artifacts on Nebius.

title: Build intelligence
that moves.
scenes.subtitle: Start with a workflow. Build toward your next capability.
scenes.narration: From synthetic data to intelligent action. Nebius Physical AI Workbench. Build intelligence that moves.
